description: Poll a generation or upscale task by its id. IMPORTANT: finished media URLs are kept for 7 days only — result.expires_at is the exact time the URL stops working; download or re-host anything the user wants to keep. status is one of "pending" | "processing" | "queued" | "completed" | "failed". When "completed", the media URL is in result.url (videos/images) or result.songs (music). When "failed", details are in error. Poll every few seconds until completed or failed.

task_id.description: The task id returned by vicsee_generate / vicsee_upscale_*
